_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for Myrtle Beach & the Grand Strand. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: Blue Wave Adventures Dolphin Watch
deals.deal: $3 off each ticket with email sign-up code
deals.details: Sign up for the newsletter and apply the code at checkout. Tours leave from Crazy Sister Marina; times vary by conditions and season.

deals.name: Cane Patch Driving Range
deals.deal: $1 off small and medium baskets, $2 off large baskets
deals.details: Year-round coupon from Myrtle Beach Family Golf.

deals.name: Myrtle Beach Family Golf
deals.deal: $1 off a round or $2 off all-day play
deals.details: Year-round coupon for Captain Hook's, Jungle Safari, Jurassic Golf and Shipwreck Island. Not all courses are open year-round.

deals.name: Paradise Adventure Golf
deals.deal: $1 off a single round before 6 PM or $4.50 off an all-day pass
deals.details: Coupon on the website covers Cancun Lagoon, Molten Mountain and Mutiny Bay. Off-season hours vary by location.

deals.name: Ripley's Believe It or Not! Myrtle Beach
deals.deal: 50% off for Horry County residents; 30% off for military
deals.details: Military and first responders get 30% off single-attraction tickets and 15% off U-pick combos. Discounts are at the ticket counter only, with ID.

deals.name: Ripley's Crazy Golf Myrtle Beach
deals.deal: 50% off for Horry County residents
deals.details: Military and first responders get 30% off single-attraction tickets; AAA members get $2 off adult and $1 off child tickets. Ticket counter only, with ID.

deals.name: Sea Thunder Dolphin Cruise
deals.deal: $3 off each adult ticket with code 3off
deals.details: Regular prices are $33 adults and teens, $28 seniors and $23 kids 3-12. Reservations recommended; check the booking calendar for off-season sailings.

deals.name: Angelo's Steak & Pasta
deals.deal: $3 domestic beer, house wine and house liquor; 2 sliders for $3
deals.details: Happy hour is for bar seating only. Shareables such as calamari and mozzarella sticks are $7.95.

deals.name: Backyard Sports Bar & Grill
deals.deal: $4 house liquor and domestic beer, $4.50 house wine
deals.details: Weekday happy hour also includes 25% off select appetizers and $1 off import and tall domestic drafts.

deals.name: Barnacle Bill's Rum & Raw Bar
deals.deal: $2 canned beers, $2.75 bottled beers, $3.50 house liquors, 50-cent wings
deals.details: Weekday happy hour. Tuesdays also have $2 margaritas all day.

deals.name: Crave Italian Restaurant
deals.deal: $6 house liquors, $7.50 house wines, $4 domestic bottles, $1 off drafts
deals.details: Happy hour cocktails are $7.50-$9 and a happy hour food menu includes an $8 burger and $11 brick oven pizza. Excludes holidays and special events; Myrtle Beach and North Myrtle Beach locations.
deals.location: Myrtle Beach and North Myrtle Beach locations

deals.name: Local on the Water
deals.deal: $5 Tito's, Jack Daniel's, Captain Morgan, Bacardi and house wines; $3.75 16 oz domestic drafts
deals.details: House margaritas are $6 and five-beer domestic buckets $18. Happy hour food includes $8 wings and $10 peel-and-eat shrimp.

deals.name: Quigley's Pint & Plate
deals.deal: $5 pints, $5 house wines and liquors
deals.details: Bar-area happy hour also includes discounted appetizers. Mondays add $5 Smirnoff vodka and $6 Moscow Mules.

deals.name: The Goat Bar & Grill
deals.deal: $1 off appetizers; $3.50 Miller Lite drafts all day
deals.details: Happy hour runs daily; the Miller Lite draft price applies all day, every day.

deals.name: Tin Roof Myrtle Beach
deals.deal: Tue: $5 house margaritas, $4 Coronas, $1 off tacos
deals.details: Other nights: Wed $5 Rumple Minze, Jameson and Fireball; Thu $1 off drafts and $4 well liquors; Fri-Sat $3 16 oz PBR and $5 Fireball or Pink Whitney.
deals.hours: During open hours (opens 4 PM Tue-Thu, 11 AM Fri-Sat)

deals.name: Barnacle Bill's Rum & Raw Bar
deals.deal: $2 tacos on Tuesday; $1 oysters on Friday and Sunday
deals.details: Taco Tuesday has $2 chicken, beef, shrimp, steak or fish tacos (1-11 PM). Oysters, raw or steamed, are $1 on Friday and Sunday from 11 AM to 11 PM.
deals.hours: Tue 1-11 PM; Fri and Sun 11 AM-11 PM

deals.name: Boardwalk Billy's
deals.deal: Half-pound crab legs $12; $8 shrimp, clams, mussels and wings; sushi rolls from $3.99
deals.details: Happy hour also takes $1 off any adult beverage.

deals.name: Chesapeake House
deals.deal: Early bird entrees $16.95-$26.95 with salad or slaw and a side
deals.details: Includes fried shrimp ($22.95), an early bird platter of flounder, shrimp and deviled crab ($25.95) and baked spaghetti ($16.95). Cards carry a 3% fee.

deals.name: Dirty Don's Oyster Bar & Grill
deals.deal: Half-price shrimp, wings, mussels, clams and crawdads
deals.details: Weekday happy hour also has reduced drink prices. The page does not say which of the three locations take part.
deals.location: 408 21st Ave. N (also Oceanfront and Market Common)

deals.name: Filet's Waterfront
deals.deal: $7.75 and $9.75 appetizers; half-dozen oysters or cheeseburger $10.75
deals.details: Happy hour also has $3.25 domestic beers, $4 house wines and $1 off drafts. Happy hour sushi is Monday-Thursday only.

deals.name: Quigley's Pint & Plate
deals.deal: Tue: select dinner entrees $10; Thu: unlimited shrimp with dinner salad $28
deals.details: The Tuesday deal covers five select dinner entrees from 4 PM to close. Saturdays have half-off wine bottles and $28 unlimited ribs.

pending.note: Site advertises specials; server error. Confirm (surfsidecharlies.com).

pending.note: Page for $1.50 house oysters exists; fetch failed. Confirm days/hours (theclawhouse.com).

pending.note: Leads: $5 off for Horry/Georgetown/Brunswick/New Hanover residents; own offer pages failed to load. Confirm (hollywoodwaxentertainment.com).

pending.note: $1 off a round coupon; terms are only in a coupon image/PDF. Confirm (mtatlanticusminotaurgoff.com).

pending.name: Bonefish Grill Surfside Beach
pending.note: Page says happy hour from 4 PM daily and cocktails from $7, but no location prices; closed Thursdays. Confirm (bonefishgrill.com).

pending.name: Ripley's Aquarium / WonderWorks / Broadway Grand Prix
pending.note: Leads report locals discounts (50% Horry County; Broadway Grand Prix local pit pass $49.99). Not confirmed on own pages. Confirm (ripleys.com, wonderworksonline.com).
